title: Require Domain Model Policy Owner Shape
forbids: domain model policy files outside their exact pure-policy dependency, import-source, re-export, and non-authority shape
why: Domain model policy owns reusable semantic constants and pure resolution, not schema construction, structural validation, artifact admission, operation envelopes, or stage authoring. Source-level authority rejects schema and validation packages regardless of local aliases while preserving type-only model dependencies.
remediate: Keep reusable semantic constants, tables, defaults, and pure resolvers in model/policy; keep relative dependencies inside sibling policy and type-only model schema surfaces; move schema construction, structural validation, and every other concern to its actual owner.
message: Domain model policy files must remain pure reusable policy without artifact, operation, recipe, or stage authority.
